what: A 74px round ring arrow button. On hover the gradient ring turns off over .4s and a pale gray ring turns on, then .4s later the gradient ring is redrawn once around over .4s (stroke-dashoffset 99 → 2). The arrow inside the ring blinks gray for 1s and returns, and the side text fades to .7. On release the drawn ring erases over .4s and .6s later the original ring returns (all ease-in-out). At first, when it touches the bottom 20% line of the screen, it floats up from 10% below over 1s ease.

options.enter: If none, does not float up at first
options.start: Rising line — what % from the bottom of the screen, default 20
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Empty slot for the ring (if empty, an SVG is drawn in)
options.--fx-gap: Gap between ring and text, default 18px
options.--fx-ring-a / b / c: Ring gradient three points (lower right → center → upper left), default --kf-accent-text · --kf-accent · --kf-accent
options.--fx-track: Pale ring / blinking arrow color, default --kf-line
options.--fx-wait: Delay before drawing again after hover, default .4s (original old jQuery button .6s)
options.--fx-arrow-in: Time for the arrow to return from its faded color after release, default 1.6s (old plate 1.44s)

from.where: index.html .np-more (How to use·About·Pricing·Cases ‹See more› button) · sub-page page-turn button
